newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa opens branch in Finland.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa opens branch in Finland.

text.p: Swedish insurance company Trygg-Hansa said on Tuesday it was going to open a branch in Helsinki, Finland, in April.
The Helsinki office will oversee Trygg-Hansa's interests in business and industrial insurances in Finland, Trygg-Hansa said in a statement.

"Thereby we will be able to help our customers who have assets in Finland and work on the Finnish market of company and industry insurance through direct sales as well as sales via brokers," Fredrik Rosencrantz, a company division manager said.
